title: Offensive stats
intro: Per-play efficiency for every offense. EPA is expected points added; success means the play gained enough to stay on schedule. Explosive plays are passes of 15+ yards or runs of 10+. Pressure rate is pressures allowed per dropback.

columns.label: Havoc rate allowed
columns.note: Share of run and pass plays that end in a sack, tackle for loss, pass breakup, interception or lost fumble

columns.label: Havoc allowed: sacks
columns.note: Share of run and pass plays; the four parts add up to the havoc rate (turnover first, then sack, tackle for loss, pass breakup)
